PE.name: Chilco Hembra
PE.citation: Bussmann & Sharon (2015), Plantas Medicinales de los Andes y la Amazonia, p.95: 'ASTERACEAE - Ayapana amygdalina (Lam.) R.M. King & H. Rob. Chilco Hembra. Arbusto, Amazonico, Andino, Costa, 0-2000m. Uso: Irritacion de piel / Hojas y Tallos, fresco / Topico'. Kept narrow to this one country: the genus Ayapana has 17 accepted species and a loosely shared 'ayapana'/'chilco' common-name cluster across them, so no other country's name was attributed to this specific species without direct confirmation.
